description: Public transit route patterns (bus, rail, streetcar and the three cable car lines: mode "cable" is the cable car track) and stops, local metres. Route paths may run outside the built tiles; stops are inside them. Liveries are the game's own.
attribution: Transit routes and stops, traffic signals, crosswalks, parking regulations: SFMTA via DataSF (9exe-acju, i28k-bkz6, ybh5-27n2, g9zy-srvv, hi6h-neyh), ODC PDDL 1.0.
